title.narrative: Providing oxygen supply to maternity hospitals in Manaus, Brazil - Covid-19

description.narrative: Strengthen the oxygen supply capacity of State Maternities in Manaus, severely affected by the worsening of the Covid-19 pandemic in 2021, providing and installing a small oxygen plant that could partially and sustainably supply their increasing demand. With a focus on maternal and child health, the project will guarantee the emergency care of premature newborns, newborns and pregnant women with Covid-19 and obstetric and gynaecological surgeries, critically compromised by the lack of medicinal oxygen in Amazonas.
